form

Form. It submits the switch, input, checkbox, slider, radio, and picker entered by the user in the component.

When the button component whose form-type is submit in the form is tapped, value of the form component is submitted. You need to add name to the form component as the key.

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
bindsubmit eventHandle No Triggers the submit event when the data in the form is carried. The output is event.detail = {value : {'name': 'value'} , formId: ''}.
bindreset eventHandle No Triggers the reset event when the form is reset.

Sample Code


<form bindsubmit='submit' bindreset='reset' id='form'>
  <view>
    <view>radio</view>
    <radio-group name='radio' id='radioGroup'>
      <label>
        <radio value='radio1' id='radio1' />
        radio1
      </label>
      <label>
        <radio value='radio2' id='radio2' />
        radio2
      </label>
    </radio-group>
  </view>

  <view>
    <button id='submit' type='primary' formType='submit'>Submit</button>
    <button id='reset' formType='reset'>Reset</button>
  </view>
</form>

Page({
  submit: function(e) {
    console.log(e.detail.value)
  },
  reset: function() {
    console.log('rest')
  }
})
